Curtain Pattern Cuts

Measure the roll's head phase and pattern repeat, then enter each panel's finished height and hems in sewing order to get every cut mark from the same roll head, the pattern-matching waste, and whether the roll is long enough.

Leaving this page or switching language resets the draft.

Roll head and repeat

Length from the roll head to the usable end, 1–100000 mm.

The vertical length of one full motif; enter 0 for plain cloth.

The motif position at the roll head, measured from a fixed reference point within one repeat.

The motif position each finished top edge should land on.

Enter panels in sewing order. Names must be unique; at most 16 panels.
